title: Prizegiving 2026 – Celebrating Our Achievements
excerpt: Celebrating the achievements, hard work and dedication of our students at Rosehill College Prizegiving 2026.
body:
A look back at our Prizegiving 2026, celebrating the achievements and hard work of our students throughout the year.

Congratulations to all our award recipients. Your dedication and commitment are something to be proud of.

We also say a special farewell to our departing Year 13s. Thank you for everything you have contributed to Rosehill College. We wish you all the very best for whatever comes next.

Congratulations, everyone!
